details.description: Grok 4.20 Non-reasoning is xAI's non-reasoning chat model in the Grok 4 series; xAI's release notes say Grok 4.20 went live on March 10, 2026. `grok-4.20-beta-0309-non-reasoning` is xAI's API alias for the March 9, 2026 dated snapshot, accepting text and image input and producing text output. Per xAI's own model configuration it lacks the extended-reasoning feature that the paired reasoning model has. xAI has since shipped newer Grok releases (4.3, 4.5, 4.6 and 4.7). Artificial Analysis, a third-party benchmarking site, lists this snapshot as deprecated in favor of Grok 4.3 (Non-reasoning), though xAI's own May 2026 model-retirement guidance does not include Grok 4.20 among the models being retired or redirected.
advantages: Supports function calling and structured outputs, per xAI's published model configuration.
Artificial Analysis measured about 93 output tokens per second for this model, faster than the 68 token/s median it reported for comparable non-reasoning models.
disadvantages: Has no extended-reasoning feature in xAI's model configuration, unlike the paired grok-4.20 reasoning variant.
Artificial Analysis lists this model as deprecated, recommending xAI's newer Grok 4.3 (Non-reasoning) instead.
use_cases: General-purpose chat and text generation without extended reasoning.
Agentic or tool-using workflows via xAI's function calling and structured outputs support.
Tasks that combine image input with text, since the model accepts both text and image input.
